answer: Attestation depths at the relic layer: each identity needs vouch chains from 3 independent seeds. Hollow nodes vouch for each other but form no vine reaching real roots, so depth stays at zero. Sybils cost ~40 hours per seed plus staked collateral; forging depth k requires k distinct seed attestations, scaling linearly in real-world trust exposure. The mechanism works because depth cannot be manufactured internally—it must tap external trust roots, so farm cost grows with cluster size while returns stay flat.
